composition_subtypes.role: core greedy decision to borrow from future groups
efficient pointer movement to find next multi-char group

payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy simulation with two-pointer borrowing from future groups with size>1, amortized pointer advances monotonically for O(n).
payload.rationale: The code implements a greedy strategy: always delete groups, and when a group is size 1, borrow from a later group with size>1. The pointer 'top' over list l1 moves only forward, giving amortized O(1) per group.
